metrics.name: ablation_llm

descriptions.full_system: Specialists + case-memory risk + calibrated fusion + cost policy + abstention + drift-aware recalibration.
descriptions.no_planner: Full system without the LLM planner (every enabled agent runs in a fixed order). Note: the planner only orders and selects agents; numeric results equal the full system, differences appear in the graph-run metrics
descriptions.no_knowledge_retrieval: Full system without knowledge retrieval. Note: knowledge snippets only ground explanations; numeric results equal the full system, differences appear in the graph-run explanation metrics
descriptions.multi_agent_no_rag: Specialist agents + calibrated stacking fusion, no retrieval.
descriptions.single_llm_agent: One LLM agent seeing all attributes with the same tools; risk from the all-features model. Note: numeric risk identical to lgbm_global by construction; differs only in the graph run (planning, explanation)

metrics.notes:
Sets: test; seeds [0]; evaluation on the natural class distribution (uniform sample capped at 400000 windows per set).
Costs: 1 unit = one planned replacement; a missed failure costs the cost ratio. 'model' escalation outcome = the reviewer applies the policy's suggested action (conservative); 'oracle' = the reviewer picks the hindsight-best action (optimistic).
single_llm_agent uses the all-features model for its risk, so its numeric metrics equal lgbm_global; no_knowledge_retrieval equals full_system numerically.
Graph runs: stratified sample of 100 test windows (30 positives), LLM mode 'live'.
